title: Aging Twin Population of Human Skeletal Muscle Biopsies
projectDescription: Skeletal muscle biopsies from a set of 33 twins (66 individuals), both young and old age.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Samples were prepared as in the published protocol by Wu et al., 2017
dataProcessingProtocol: Data were run on an AbSciex 5600, in 1 hour gradients in DIA acqusition mode over approximately 7 days continuously. The column was cleaned after the first 9 samples, but otherwise samples were run in straight order. Sample 61 had a pump injection issue and the sample was immediately reinjected. A further 7 samples at the end of the run are technical replicates.
